kits.name: Accessory Measurement & Closure Kit — Lunarness
kits.description: A native editable Penpot template for accessory designers, stylists and learning resources. Three pages contain a 16:9 cover, a 12-symbol vector reference sheet and a measurement-method handoff diagram. Two native components make the reference sheet and handoff diagram reusable. Two visible source hotspots on the handoff page open the Lunarness size guide and worked sizing calculator through native click interactions. Symbols distinguish linear span, wrap path, endpoints, closure frame, tongue, adjuster, D-ring, extender links, hole pitch, alignment, method record and withheld comparisons. Original geometry and layouts are CC BY 4.0. All drawings are illustrative: no verified product dimensions, mechanical safety or compatibility claims. Fitting context: https://lunarness.com/pages/size-guide and https://lunarness.com/pages/harness-size-calculator.

kits.description: A faithful Ant Design v6 component library as a single native Penpot file. Every component is built as a variant set with antd-exact geometry and naming, bound to a complete design-token system that mirrors antd's own architecture (seed → map → alias → components; 12 sets / 1,524 tokens; light · dark themes × default · compact densities). The file includes a documentation page for every component plus group indexes and foundations, 502 icons from @ant-design/icons, and demo screens.

kits.name: Classic Resume
kits.description:
A one-page resume with serif type, centered section headings over a thin rule, and education first. It comes in US Letter and A4.

Every line is a text layer you can type over, set in Gelasio, a free Google font that is metric compatible with Georgia. The page is built with flex layout, so when a line wraps or you duplicate a bullet, the rest of the page moves down by itself.

The layout is ATS-friendly: one main column, no tables and no icons, with dates and locations at the right end of the line they belong to. Both pages, exported to PDF from Penpot, were run through the open-source OpenResume parser, which read all 38 fields correctly.

This is the Penpot version of the Classic template from ReadableResume, where the same design is also available for Google Docs and Word. MIT License, with the full text on the Read me page in the file. The person, schools and companies in the sample are made up.

kits.name: OSS Product Management processes
kits.description: In September 2023 the Turing Institute Practitioner's hub were developing a curriculum of support they would offer their cohort members that were building open source science and research related software/data  - Superbloom developed a series of 3 and 3.5hr workshops that were centred around product management, open roadmapping and user research for open source software and open data projects. These are the resources, exercises and content that was delivered as part of those workshops, made openly available for everyone. These templates will help any OSS project at any stage of their development or creation better understand their purpose, strategy, value proposition to users and begin to plan for a flexible, open and participatory way of developing and building OSS.

kits.name: Sewlore Sewing Symbols and Measurement Diagrams
kits.description: A native Penpot library for sewing pattern annotation and measurement explanations. Twelve reusable components cover grainlines, fold lines, notches, darts, drill marks, buttons, dimension arrows and cutting/seam lines. Six pages include a cover, symbol sheet, annotated pattern example, measurement diagrams, component sources and a native editable usage note. Component geometry is native and editable; labels imported from SVG remain SVG text. Examples are illustrative calculations, not empirical fabric tests. Design and documentation were AI assisted. Released by Sewlore under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0).
